alert.name: DatabaseAlarm
alert.summary: Alert fired for PostgreSQL database warden

root_cause.hypothesis: Active connections climbing toward max_connections (63/79, ~80%) with no long-running queries, no idle-in-transaction, no lock waits, and no recent deploy — points to organic connection growth/pool sizing issue (e.g. app-side pool not releasing, traffic increase, or max_connections set too low) rather than a query/lock/deploy-triggered spike.
evidence: long_running_queries=0, idle_in_transaction=0, locks_waiting=0 — rules out stuck/blocking queries
RECENT DEPLOYS empty — no deploy correlation
LOGS empty — no error/query detail to pinpoint source

proposal.reasoning: Connections 63/79 (80%), climbing, no long-running queries, no idle-in-transaction, no lock waits, no recent deploy. Pattern fits organic traffic growth or app-side pool misconfig, not a query/lock/deploy incident. No safe automated fix exists (restart/terminate would just mask symptom, could drop live app requests); needs human to check app pool config or bump max_connections.
proposal.expected_effect: Human investigates pool sizing/traffic cause before connections exhaust max_connections; no immediate automated change made.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
